About us

Oakbridge builds property management software for residential landlords and property managers. We started in 2014 with a rent ledger and a shared inbox for maintenance requests.

Today more than 4,000 property managers use Oakbridge for rent collection, tenant screening and lease management across 310,000 rental units.

Our team

Sixty people in two offices, most of whom have managed a rental property at some point.

Our investors

Oakbridge is backed by long term investors and has been profitable since 2021.
